flags.why: The bowl sense is more useful in everyday Vietnamese than the archaic verb meaning 'to worry'.
The entry omits the insulting sense referring to a bizarre or objectionable person or thing, recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/qu%C3%A1i_thai).
flags.fix: Add noun [derogatory]: freak; monstrosity (a person or thing).

flags.why: This sense describes a tooth growing out of alignment, not general misalignment of objects such as doors, as recorded in [this dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/lay-eEfSUZ51KjbWd.html).
flags.fix: adj [rare] | growing out of alignment (of a tooth); example: Cậu bé có cái răng cửa hơi lẫy. = The boy has a slightly misaligned front tooth.

flags.why: Kế tục is a formal verb, as described in [this dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/ke-tuc-edAjiXl8iyXUA.html), and needs a register warning.

The positional restriction is false because quá đỗi also precedes adjectives, as in quá đỗi quen thuộc in [this usage](https://vnexpress.net/duoi-hinh-bat-chu-thanh-ngu-tuc-ngu-tuc-ngu-nao-an-sau-rung-tre-xanh-nay-5051395.html).
flags.fix: extremely; exceedingly (before or after an adjective)
